blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Prosecutors from the International Criminal Court (ICC) said they plan to present an initial lineup of five key witnesses in the trial of former President Rodrigo Duterte, and defended the inclusion of an evidentiary archive containing open-source newspaper reports on Duterte’s tenure as mayor of Davao City. During the status conference, prosecution and defense counsel discussed the scope and management of evidence in a trial record spanning more than 18,000 items. At the outset, Senior Trial Lawyer Julian Nicholls confirmed that five witnesses are expected to testify in person before the court’s Christmas recess. The witnesses are identified […]...
